message: provider.register() looks like a tracer provider's, but this tool couldn't tie provider to one new NodeTracerProvider or new WebTracerProvider imported by name, so it was not expanded. If it is a NodeTracerProvider or WebTracerProvider, set the globals by hand with trace.setGlobalTracerProvider, context.setGlobalContextManager and propagation.setGlobalPropagator, since TracerProvider has no register().
